scope: Body-text reflow around square/tight/through floats and recursive nested-table rendering

wrapReflow.implementation: square/tight/through floats render as in-flow CSS floats (not absolute overlays) before the anchor block; side and margins derive from float x/width; shape-outside covers rect/roundRect/ellipse; behind/front/topAndBottom stay as overlays

nestedTables.implementation: recursive ng-template (tableTemplate) renders child WordNestedTable at any depth; rowOffset keeps pagination slicing correct

remaining: A wrap float cannot be placed above its anchor block (margin-top only pushes downward)
VBA macros cannot run in the browser (same as Word for the web)
